name: CAO
tagline: Turns a botched promise or missed deadline into an apology worth actually sending
description: An apology-drafting desk for the moment you dropped the ball on a promise or a delivery. It names the specific harm, skips the excuse-making, and lands on a concrete repair, set out in four steps. The draft stops there: you read it, edit it, and decide whether it ever gets sent.
author: LYP0x0
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
